content: **Pre-flight (architect).** Migration 17: evidence_jobs queue + actions.evidence_car_cid column. polaris-backend/src/evidence/{worker,blob_store,mod}.rs with trait + 3 impls (in-memory, local-fs, s3-stub). UNIQUE on evidence_car_cid for idempotency. AC-11 binding test runs against in-memory store; S3 production wiring as #69 follow-up.
